name: run
label: Run
description: Hermes Runs API for long-form agentic sessions. Submit a run, poll its status, subscribe to events, or stop it. Designed for dashboards and async automations that want progress observability without holding a streaming connection open.

runId.description: Run ID returned by create (e.g. run_abc123)

session_id.description: External session ID. Hermes surfaces this in run status so external UIs can correlate runs with their own conversation IDs.

instructions.description: System-level instructions layered on top of Hermes' core system prompt

previous_response_id.description: Continue from a stored response — full prior conversation (including tool calls) is reconstructed.

conversation_history.description: Optional array of prior {role, content} messages to seed conversation context. Use only when not using previous_response_id.

eventTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the events SSE stream before returning. The connection is closed when the run reaches a terminal state (completed/failed/cancelled) or this timeout elapses.
